answer: Post-epoch ZK generation proofs: each epoch's work must reference a proof generated after the prior epoch closed, verified on-chain. A sybil farm needs fresh proving per identity — 500 CPU-hours and $12 per stand-in, times 1,000 fakes = $12,000/epoch. The vault of recycled stake earns nothing; the canyon of fork attempts widens each round as lagging proofs fail. Honest miners paint one pigment, unique per epoch. Cost scales linearly with fakes while payout stays flat — farming bleeds out by design.
